mil3.7.8:1.2: Bhante Nāgasena, yo jānanto pāpakammaṃ karoti yo ca ajānanto pāpakammaṃ karoti, kassa bahutaraṃ apuññan-ti. -
mil3.7.8:1.3: Thero āha: Yo kho mahārāja ajānanto pāpakammaṃ karoti tassa bahutaraṃ apuññan-ti. -
mil3.7.8:1.4: Tena hi bhante Nāgasena yo amhākaṃ rājaputto vā rājamahāmatto vā ajānanto pāpakammaṃ karoti taṃ mayaṃ diguṇaṃ daṇḍemāti. -
mil3.7.8:1.5: Taṃ kim-maññasi mahārāja: tattaṃ ayoguḷaṃ ādittaṃ sampajjalitaṃ sajotibhūtaṃ eko ajānanto gaṇheyya eko jānanto gaṇheyya, katamo balikataraṃ dayheyyāti. -
mil3.7.8:1.6: Yo kho bhante ajānanto gaṇheyya so balikataraṃ dayheyyāti. -
mil3.7.8:1.7: Evam-eva kho mahārāja yo ajānanto pāpakammaṃ karoti tassa bahutaraṃ apuññan-ti. -
